hypotheses.falsification_test: Compare out-of-sample performance of the unmodified strategy against any proposed modifications over the next 50 trades.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Maintain current strategy parameters without modification.
hypotheses.why: The strategy has a very small sample size of 48 trades across all windows, and none of the non-overlap filter candidates are validated across all three windows (W3 has insufficient trades). Modifying the strategy now carries a high risk of overfitting to noise.

hypotheses.falsification_test: Simulate a fixed stop-loss at -0.75R on historical trade logs and verify if the reduction in gross loss R significantly exceeds any loss of gross profit R from prematurely stopped winning trades.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Tighten the initial stop-loss from the current level to a maximum of 0.75R.
hypotheses.why: S07 has 47.22 R of its 47.78 R gross loss concentrated in the deep adverse MAE cluster (MAE <= -0.75R). Tightening the stop-loss to 0.75R will directly truncate these deep losses with minimal impact on the win rate, as these trades rarely recover.

hypotheses.falsification_test: Apply a break-even rule at MFE >= 0.50R to historical intratrade paths and measure the net R improvement after accounting for early exits.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Implement a break-even stop trigger once the trade MFE reaches 0.50R.
hypotheses.why: S07 has 20 losses totaling 25.99 R in the favorable-then-loss cluster where MFE >= 0.50R. Moving the stop to break-even at this threshold will eliminate these round-trip losses.
